Now for the vLog: ECH.

Seriously. I'm in Entity Component Hell. I understand how the Ashley ECS works, and I can visualize it in my head just fine. The issue I'm having is getting all of these separate systems talking and happy with one another.

For instance, I said in #13 that Scene2D is going to deal with the UI part and Ashley is going to deal with the entity part. Well, after getting about 5 hours into my sleep, I woke up to a thought. "What if an Ashley Entity needs to know something about an UI element?" Then I started thinking about how the Entity system needs to work with Tiled, because the crops are going to be Cells in the TileMap, which are going to be Ashley Entities.

Hopefully you see where this rabbit hole is going.

So after multiple vigorous ass-kickings (mostly done on my ass) in TF2, I sat down and started writing this vLog. I'm getting burnt out, plain and simple. I see all these obstacles in my way and as I'm trying to figure out how to deal with them, I wind up over thinking and getting myself flustered and demotivate myself.

I shouldn't be demotivated though. I mean, yea, I don't have anything near a game yet, but I did modify quite a bit to get a dynamic color thing working. And, truthfully, this is the farthest I've gone into making a game so far. But I need help.

So, I'm cross posting this in /v/gamedev as well as my usual cross post into /v/gamedevlog. I need to have discussions with others that either used LibGDX or on how to better manage my goals to make them more productive or rewarding or something.

Also, I know I said I was going to stream this week, but with the whole hard drive issues throwing a screw into that, I'm going to try and do a little maybe tomorrow (I would like to play Friends of Mineral Town to get a grasp on how the farm is laid out in that, because a dynamic farm layout seems like a cool idea) if hardware allows. If I do, I'll post it here and in /v/gamedev and maybe I'll get some watchers or something.
